[https://www.tiles.run/]
Tiles: A local-first, collaborative AI assistant that works for you. Tiles alpha Own your AI A local-first, collaborative AI assistant that works for you. Built with open models and decentralized protocols. Download for free Apple Silicon Linux Preview of the canary version. Why Tiles? For sensitive knowledge work or personal tasks, your AI shouldn’t require you to trust a third party with your conversations and intellectual property. Run models locally, sync chats peer-to-peer with end-to-end encryption, and use social features, such as sharing chats, built on AT Protocol . Tiles gives you user-owned keys for your digital life with DIDs and UCANs , so your data and identity truly remain yours. Use cases Individuals Plan finances, track health notes, and journal privately. Run models locally, sync across devices, and share only when you choose. Coworking spaces Turn shared compute into private AI infrastructure. Let members use local models from their own devices while keeping identity and data private. Researchers Review literature, analyze datasets, and run agents in preconfigured, resumable research sandboxes. Enterprises Deploy private agentic systems powered by open frontier models. Secure users and agents with zero-trust authentication and authorization, simplify team management, and reduce infrastructure and model costs. What's inside Run polished local models Embedded Pi agent harness for knowledge work, running Google’s gemma-4-12b on llama.cpp , with Agent Plugins support for reusable, skill-based workflows. Own your identity Tiles uses locally generated DIDs and UCANs for zero-trust authentication and authorization. This lets you own and control your identity across your digital life. Use local models on remote devices Securely run local models on a remote device like your home lab, peer-to-peer, from any device. Sync chats across your devices Encrypted peer-to-peer chat sync across your linked devices. Share chats with friends Create a public or private link to a chat session, published on Atmosphere and stored on your own personal data server (PDS). Every chat is a sandbox Coming soon Resume or share chats as sandboxed microVM environments with friends or agents across devices. Open source and free forever Tiles is open source and forever free to use, dual-licensed under MIT and Apache 2.0. It is designed to be future-proof and continue working forever. Designed for the Atmosphere Your online data lives on a Personal Data Server (PDS), and you choose who hosts it. Apps connect to you, not the other way around. No starting over when apps change or disappear. What's the Atmosphere? The Atmosphere is the growing network of apps built on the AT Protocol (ATproto), an open decentralized protocol for social applications and portable identity. For Tiles, this means social features do not need to live inside a closed platform. Learn more about the AT Protocol in the official documentation . Try Tiles now. Download for free Apple Silicon Linux

What do we Stand For?

Android Development

Our Android Development team specializes in crafting high-quality mobile applications. We leverage the latest technologies, frameworks, and architecture patterns to ensure seamless user experiences and top-notch performance.

2

Web Development

The Web Development team builds scalable and responsive web applications. We focus on front-end and back-end development, ensuring smooth user interactions, strong security, and efficient performance across all devices.

3

RnD

Our Research and Development (R&D) team explores emerging technologies, including Machine Learning (ML), the Internet of Things (IoT), and Cybersecurity. We innovate and experiment to push the boundaries of technology and solve complex challenges.

4

UI/UX

The UI/UX team creates visually appealing and user-friendly designs. We emphasize usability, accessibility, and intuitive interactions, ensuring that our digital products provide exceptional user experiences.

Explore the Android Community

Did you know? Android powers over 70% of smartphones worldwide.

Android isn't just an operating system — it's a global community of millions.

Explore Our

Events

Read Our Blogs

01

Jetpack Compose

Jetpack Compose is Android's modern toolkit for building native UI. It simplifies and accelerates UI development with less code, powerful tools, and intuitive Kotlin APIs.

02

Kotlin Coroutines

Kotlin Coroutines simplify asynchronous programming in Android, making it easier to handle tasks like network requests, database access, and more without blocking the main thread.

03

MVVM Architecture

Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) is a widely used architecture in Android development that helps separate UI logic from business logic, making code more testable and maintainable.

04

Android Jetpack Libraries

Jetpack is a suite of libraries that help developers follow best practices, reduce boilerplate code, and write robust Android apps. It includes Room, Navigation, WorkManager, and more.
